<infobox theme="Game">
	<image source="image"></image>
    <title source="name"></title>
    <navigation name="mobile-eras"><center>{{Top-mobile}}</center></navigation>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>General information</header>
        <data source="type"><label>Type of game</label></data>
        <data source="players"><label>Number of players</label></data>	
        <data source="ages"><label>Age group</label></data>
    </group>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Historical information</header>
        <data source="createdby"><label>Created by</label></data>	
        <data source="first"><label>First played</label></data>
        <data source="locations"><label>Locations</label></data>	
    </group>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Other information</header>
        <data source="affiliation"><label>Affiliation</label></data>
    </group>
	<navigation><small>{{PlainLink|//starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Template:Game|name=<nowiki>[</nowiki>Source<nowiki>]</nowiki>}}</small></navigation>
</infobox>{{PreloadCat}}<!-- TEMPLATE ENDS HERE.

==Usage instructions==
Copy and paste the following code into the top of the article, filling the appropriate fields. Omitted or blank fields will not be shown on the article page.

<pre><nowiki>{{Top|}}
{{Game
|image=
|name=
|type=
|players=
|ages=
|createdby=
|first=
|locations=
|affiliation=
}}</nowiki></pre></noinclude>
